title: Consolidated single-transfer snapshot with preallocated buffers
hypothesis: Consolidating snapshot device-to-host copy into a single preallocated buffer (including dynamic_mask and free_passes) and using pinned host memory avoids 4 separate DtoH round-trips and repeated GPU memory allocations.
change: Added TIER_EXTENDED_SPECS, preallocated _snap_packed_buf and _snap_host_buf in TorchFoveatedGrid.__init__, and updated snapshot() to execute single torch.cat into preallocated buffer and single DtoH transfer.
expected_effect: Reduce snapshot latency by 2-3 ms per frame without altering cell layout or detached snapshot contract.
correctness_result: 51/51 tests passing in test_grid, test_grid_torch, test_runtime_integration; bit-identical snapshot content verified.
memory_result: Persistent grid memory unchanged at 5.12 MB (16 bytes/cell); zero dynamic allocations during snapshot.
